title: DeLonge's advisers went quiet when asked about hybrids

tellings.quote: So De Long, when he came out, he was like, there's a big genetic component to this. And he said, I you know, I asked my advisors these questions, these questions, but the moment I asked them about hybrids, they were like, went quiet.

plain: Around 2016 and 2017, the rock musician Tom DeLonge, when he went public about UFOs, said there was a big genetic side to the subject. He said his advisers answered his other questions, but went quiet the moment he asked about hybrids, meaning mixes of human and alien. The researcher Jason Simosa repeats this as something DeLonge said, and tells it because the silence would suggest hybrids are a topic the people in the know will not touch.
